description: This file contains functions for parsing and extracting queue directives from text, including handling options like debounce, cap, drop policy, and queue mode.

methods.name: parseQueueDebounce
methods.description: Parses a raw string to determine debounce duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: parseQueueCap
methods.description: Parses a raw string to determine queue capacity as a number.

methods.name: parseQueueDirectiveArgs
methods.description: Parses arguments for the queue directive from a raw string.

methods.name: extractQueueDirective
methods.description: Extracts and cleans queue directive from a given string body.
